label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.6 a.2 co: All desired perfections flow from GOD_4 as from…
locator: I q.6 a.2 co.: inquantum omnes perfectiones desideratae effluunt ab eo, sicut a prima causa
interpretation: God is the supreme good simply because all desired perfections flow from him as from their first cause, not as from a univocal agent, so the good is in him most excellently. Kept as prose: it states of God what the open bridge STMT-CAUSE-OF-BEING-CAUSES-EVERY-PERFECTION states of any cause of being, and supports it without stating it. Full-article re-reading preserves the desired-perfection, first-cause and nonunivocal qualifications. It does not assert a universally quantified transfer for every cause, nor identify an arbitrary universal esse source with God. See docs/notes/causal-perfection-transfer.md.
